title: Protecting Your Plants During Exterior Cleaning
excerpt: Don't let pressure washing harm your landscaping. Learn how to safeguard your plants and garden during exterior cleaning in Jonesborough, TN.
content:
As a homeowner in Jonesborough, TN, you take pride in your property's exterior, from the siding to the landscaping. However, when it comes to exterior cleaning, many homeowners worry about the potential damage to their plants and garden. At Mist and Main, we understand the importance of plant protection during exterior cleaning and want to reassure you that with the right precautions, your plants can thrive even after a thorough wash.

## Why Plant Protection Matters
When it comes to exterior cleaning, plants are often the most vulnerable to damage. Harsh chemicals, high-pressure washing, and lack of care can all take a toll on your landscaping. Not only can this damage the aesthetic of your property, but it can also harm the environment and your family's health.

### Pre-Wash Precautions
Before we begin any exterior cleaning project, we take the time to assess the property and identify potential risks to plants. This includes:

* Covering plants and gardens with tarps or plastic sheets to prevent chemical overspray
* Removing any sensitive plants or flowers from the area
* Trimming back branches or foliage that may be in the way of our equipment
* Setting up a containment system to prevent chemicals from entering storm drains or waterways

## Chemical Safety and Plant Protection
We use a specially formulated cleaning solution that is designed to be gentle on plants while still effectively cleaning your exterior surfaces. Our solution is:

| Chemical | Concentration | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sodium hypochlorite | 3-5% | Disinfectant and sanitizer |
| Surfactant | 1-2% | Reduces surface tension and improves cleaning power |
| Enzyme-based additive | 0.5-1% | Breaks down organic matter and prevents re-growth |

### Post-Wash Care
After the cleaning is complete, we take the time to thoroughly rinse the area and remove any tarps or coverings. We also provide guidance on how to care for your plants after the wash, including:

* Watering schedules to help plants recover from any stress
* Fertilization recommendations to promote healthy growth
* Pruning and trimming tips to maintain your plants' shape and appearance

## Trust the Experts at Mist and Main
At Mist and Main, we are dedicated to providing top-notch exterior cleaning services that not only leave your property looking its best but also protect your plants and garden. Our team of experts is trained to handle even the most delicate landscaping, and we use only the safest and most effective cleaning solutions.
